facts.text: The Reserve of Punta Maroma is located 12 miles north of Playa del Carmen.
facts.excerpt: The Reserve of Punta Maroma and its untouched, serene coastline is one of the Riviera Maya’s best-kept secrets, located 12 miles north of Playa del Carmen.

facts.text: Chablé Maroma is nestled amidst a lush, protected natural area.
facts.excerpt: Here, nestled amidst a lush, protected natural area, life blooms in the jungle as openness beckons above the brilliant blue sea.

facts.text: The resort has a 650-foot private beach.
facts.excerpt: Explore the powdery expanse of a 650-foot private beach that lines 758 acres of turquoise ocean.

facts.text: The resort is located directly on Maroma Beach, with immediate access to the Caribbean Sea.
facts.excerpt: Yes, the resort is located directly on Maroma Beach, offering immediate access to the Caribbean Sea.

facts.text: Interior designer Paulina Morán designed the villas, with nature and Mexican artisanal traditions as a focus.
facts.excerpt: Renowned interior designer Paulina Morán has imagined each space to cocoon you in luxury. Nature is a central focus, as is the feeling of closeness to Mexican artisanal traditions.

facts.text: Each villa has a private outdoor terrace and pool.
facts.excerpt: Each villa has a private outdoor terrace and pool where you can let your thoughts drift, replaced by the sounds of birds and gently rustling palm fronds.

facts.text: Villas have floor-to-ceiling windows and indoor-outdoor showers.
facts.excerpt: Sunlight and moonlight drift over the interior space through floor-to-ceiling windows. Indoor-outdoor showers invite restorative reflections.

facts.text: Treetop Pool Villas are elevated on the second floor with a private plunge pool.
facts.excerpt: Each Treetop Pool Villa and Treetop Double Pool Villa is elevated, offering breathtaking views of the lush vegetation and lovingly tended grounds that can only be found from their second-floor perch.

facts.text: The Serenity Pool Villa has a private terrace with a heated plunge pool.
facts.excerpt: from your private terrace with heated plunge pool, a sky reflected in breathtaking blue invites you to fully relax into the present

facts.text: The Presidential Villa has three bedrooms over a two-story layout with plunge pools on both floors.
facts.excerpt: Its sumptuous two-story layout offers a master space and ample living area with a side-perimeter plunge pool, plus a separate room, terrace and plunge pool on the second floor for additional guests.

facts.text: Bathrooms have separate his-and-hers water closets, and villas have a Nespresso machine.
facts.excerpt: Comforts like separate his-and-hers water closets in the bath area, plush slippers and robes and a Nespresso machine add to your enjoyment.
